descriptions.w3d_d24b_land_damage_add_8009d430: Land damage accumulator: adds the amount to the entry of the current cell (globals 0x804b17a8, 0x804b17ac) in the list at +56 and returns 0 below 15.0; when the entry total or a new amount reaches 15.0 posts the land clear message (0x801040d0) and the blast message at the position 0x8043ae20 (0x800b92a4, 10.0), resets the entry to 0.0 and returns 1; otherwise appends a new 16-byte entry and returns 1.
